claim_text:
Safety is our highest priority and we are pleased to note that through the integration process we not only maintained but improved safety performance, with the Group TRIFR improving from 14.1 at
31 December 2024 to 5.9 at 30 June 2025.
context_text: Since Greatland completed the acquisition of Telfer, the continued focus on visible field leadership (providing leaders with the right tools and information to lead by example and timely feedback and support) has seen significant improvements in Telfer’s recordable injuries, with the Group TRIFR improving from 14.1 at 31 December 2024 to 5.9 at 30 June 2025. There were no fatalities at the Group’s projects during the year.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The report states that safety performance improved after the acquisition, and the disclosed safety metrics show Group TRIFR improving from 14.1 to 5.9, with no LTIs reported in FY25.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that safety performance improved during the integration process, specifically that Group TRIFR improved from 14.1 at 31 December 2024 to 5.9 at 30 June 2025. The provided context text explicitly states the same measured TRIFR values and dates (“Group TRIFR improving from 14.1 at 31 December 2024 to 5.9 at 30 June 2025”), which substantively verifies the numerical improvement as written. The evidence also supports the broader safety-performance improvement framing by noting “significant improvements in Telfer’s recordable injuries” and “There were no fatalities at the Group’s projects during the year.”
